description: Machine-readable Core layer contract (CO2). Human contract: docs/layer-contract.md — edit both together. Enforced by scripts/lint-layer-contract.mjs as a blocking step in npm run check.
typeOnlyNote: import type / export type imports are type bridges and do not create runtime coupling; runtime imports must follow allowedRuntimeImports.

blessedImports.reason: Data migration backfills dimension ids and must use the single DimensionRegistry source of truth instead of duplicating the id list. Scope: this migration file only.

Semantic chunking lazily consumes the blessed core analysis leaf (parseToTree) with graceful fallback when grammars are absent; extends the 2026-06-12 core-as-leaf ruling to vector chunking. Permanent blessing, scope: this file only.

matrixBlessings.reason: core/ is the user-blessed importable analysis leaf (2026-06-12): GuardCheckEngine needs real AST analysis; an adapter layer would duplicate the analyzer surface.

subAreaRules.reason: core/ast is the syntax layer (parser runtime, language plugins, extractors); everything else in the analysis leaf is built on top of it and must not be imported back (2026-10-01 analysis re-architecture, P2).
core/facts turns one source text into symbols and occurrences using only the syntax layer; linking, discovery and framework knowledge sit above it (2026-10-01 analysis re-architecture, P2).

core/linking connects occurrences to declarations from file facts through ModuleGraphAccess; it never parses source or reads the filesystem itself, so the same facts always link the same way (2026-10-01 analysis re-architecture, P3).
